title: Benchmark Graphite & Anode Market Update
gist: Member-only Benchmark Week 2026 video page for Head of Prices Daisy Jennings-Gray's graphite and anode market update (Nov 10, 2026). No transcript; the agenda says it covers natural versus synthetic graphite, anode capacity growth and the development of global anode supply chains.

insights.claim: Benchmark Mineral Intelligence's graphite and anode market update frames the market around natural versus synthetic graphite.
insights.speaker: Daisy Jennings-Gray, Head of Prices, Benchmark Mineral Intelligence
insights.so_what: The natural-versus-synthetic split shapes which graphite producers and projects benefit from anode demand.

insights.claim: Benchmark's Daisy Jennings-Gray covers anode capacity growth and the development of global anode supply chains at Benchmark Week 2026. The video is member-only and the page gives no capacity or price figures.
insights.speaker: Daisy Jennings-Gray, Head of Prices, Benchmark Mineral Intelligence
insights.so_what: Anode supply chains outside the incumbent hubs are developing, but the numbers are behind the paywall.
insights.quote: anode capacity growth and the development of global anode supply chains

source_meta.author: Daisy Jennings-Gray, Head of Prices, Benchmark Mineral Intelligence
